rationale: PINS the DEFAULT-package case for `exports`, and it pins it as a REFUSAL. JLS 7.4.2: a type in the unnamed package cannot be referred to from a named package, so it cannot be imported by name from anywhere, so publishing it would assert a reachability the language denies. The analyzer's exports condition requires a non-empty package for exactly this reason, and this fixture is the only thing that makes dropping that condition a failure rather than a silent over-publication. It also pins the empty-endpoint half of standing rule R7: with no package declaration the edge's SOURCE would be the empty string, and an empty endpoint is an invented name. Nothing is expected here — the whole content of this fixture is its forbid list.
